subject: Scaling [COMPANY]'s ML pipeline
text:
Hi [NAME],

Thought our upcoming session on AI-powered smart city infrastructure could be interesting for [COMPANY].

On 30 September, Friedrich Münke, Director of Data Science at vialytics, will share his experience scaling ML pipeline to power the future of smart cities.

In this practical 45-minute session, you'll get a behind-the-scenes look at how vialytics:
Unified a fragmented ML pipeline into a single scalable data layer. Tripled dataset sizes and increased data diversity to improve model performance. Applied human-in-the-loop systems to enhance label quality and tackle rare edge cases. Whether you're scaling your own ML pipelines or looking to improve data workflows, this session is packed with real-world lessons you can bring to your next team meeting.

Save your spot here: [LINK]

subject: [NAME] - post-IAA catch-up
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Spoke to your colleague Lukas Habermayr at IAA who recommended I reach out for a chat,

For context, I lead an AV annotation team at Encord - working with Wayve, Woven-by-Toyota, Oxa and a bunch of other ADAS teams - providing the platform to support annotations of VLMs, Video, and 3D point cloud across complex Multimodal use cases.

From the chat with Lukas, sounded like you have a handle on things in-house - but do let me know if you'd be open to learning how other frontier teams are approaching annotations & will be happy to chat,

subject: partnership with [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the partnership with Recall Results! We're seeing a lot of
momentum in the digital authentication space. As you scale, I imagine the
hard part is keeping recognition models sharp across edge cases such as
spoofing attempts, and diverse demographics.

We've been helping CV teams from companies like Onfido, Veriff & iProov
solve exactly this problem with annotation workflows for face, biometrics
and documents, plus automated QA that cut costs and speed up model
iteration.

Quick context on Encord: we're a data development platform for advanced CV
and multimodal AI (text, images, videos, etc). We bring data curation,
annotation, workflow management, QA & model evaluation into one place, so
teams can focus more on building better AI models.

Would love to see if there's a fit for us partnering. I'm flexible Tuesday
to Thursdays if you are open to a quick chat.

text:

control over their model quality.

Would you be open to a quick chat to see if this could complement your
current setup? I'm flexible Tuesday to Thursday if you are open to chat.

subject: CVPR + Google Research Scholar Award + Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've not yet been introduced. I'm [SENDER] and run industrial partnerships at
Encord. I came across your profile while researching CVPR and noticed your
Google Research Scholar Award. Really impressive to see your academic
achievements translating into impactful commercial success at [COMPANY]. It's
rare to see industrial AI simultaneously drive profitability and
sustainability.

From what I understand, [COMPANY] has been sensor-driven in its optimization
models. I'm curious whether you see a role for computer vision alongside
that work. Leaders we support (Baker Hughes, Zeitview, Buzz Solutions)
often combine CV inspection (e.g. defect detection, leak monitoring, asset
condition tracking, etc) with process optimization to create a fuller
operational picture.

That's where Encord comes in: our platform streamlines the data side of CV
development (curation, annotation, QA, model evaluation) so teams can
iterate faster while retaining full control of their pipelines. Not sure
how familiar you are with Encord: we're a data development platform built
for advanced CV and multimodal AI (image, video, 3D, point cloud). We're ~5
years old with 100+ employees and raised $50M+ in funding.

Would you be open to a short chat to compare notes on scaling industrial AI
and where visual inspection could (or might not) fit into [COMPANY]'s roadmap?

I'd be happy to send an invite along accordingly.
